name: Spielefest Wien
organizer: Skilled Events and New Media GmbH
blurb: A board and card game festival at Austria Center Vienna, with a free game library, tabletop tournaments and a co-located Esports Festival.
notes: Homepage is a post-event recap ('SPIELEFEST WIEN 11. - 12. Juli 2026 ... Vielen Dank an 28.700 Besucher:innen') with no next date announced, so editions is empty and that July 2026 show is 'last'. Organizer confirmed via the site's own Impressum: 'Spielefest Wien wird durch Skilled Events and New Media GmbH veranstaltet' (refines the batch note's 'skilled New Media GmbH'). Co-located with an Esports Festival at the same venue/dates, per the homepage text, as the batch note said. No og:image is set on this page; cover uses the official Spielefest Wien logo instead.
